 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Keep each full-color separator line and one representative from every gap.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) > 1 and len(set(row)) <= 3 and all(v == row[0] for v in row[:1])]
    # Separators are rows/columns whose varying cells show a single repeated non-background color,
    # while the other cells share the background; detect by multiple values and a dominant value.
    # In these ARC patterns separator rows/columns are uniform except at separator intersections.
    bg = 0
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v == row[0] for v in row) >= w - 3 and len(set(row)) > 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) >= h - 3 and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) > 1]
    def sampled(n, lines):
        out = []
        start = 0
        for k in lines:
            if start < k:
                out.append(start)
            out.append(k)
            start = k + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append(start)
        return out
    rows, cols = sampled(h, row_lines), sampled(w, col_lines)
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
